problem:
Title: Basis (Hilbert Space)/Examples/Real Vector Space

Let $\R^d$ be the [[Definition:Real Vector Space|real vector space]] with $d$ dimensions.

Let $e_1, \ldots, e_d$ be the [[Definition:Standard Basis|standard basis]].

Then $\set {e_1, \ldots, e_d}$ is a [[Definition:Basis (Hilbert Space)|basis]] for the [[Definition:Hilbert Space|Hilbert space]] $\R^d$.
